finalText:
Perfect! All weekend tickets have been triaged. Here's the summary:

## Triage Complete

**14 tickets triaged from the new queue:**

### Queue Hygiene (2 tickets closed)
- **T-2014**: Auto-reply, closed
- **T-2010**: Marketing spam, closed

### Tickets Triaged by Severity

**sev1 (Incident Command escalation, 60 min response):**
- T-2015 (payroll/department) → E-201 Ines Kovac, deadline 09:10 UTC

**sev2 (Platform-primary escalation, 240 min response):**
- T-2007 (security/credential exposure) → E-601 Noor Haddad, deadline 12:10 UTC
- T-2013 (VPN/department) → E-303 Sanna Virtanen*, deadline 12:10 UTC
- T-2004 (CRM/department) → E-201 Ines Kovac, deadline 12:10 UTC
- T-2011 (payroll/team) → E-201 Ines Kovac, deadline 12:10 UTC
- T-2003 (build-pipeline/department) → E-101 Dana Whitfield, deadline 12:10 UTC
- T-2012 (build-pipeline/team) → E-101 Dana Whitfield, deadline 12:10 UTC

**sev3 (No escalation, 480 min business hours response):**
- T-2001 (VPN/team) → E-303 Sanna Virtanen*, deadline 17:00 UTC today
- T-2005 (CRM/team) → E-201 Ines Kovac, deadline 17:00 UTC today
- T-2006 (payroll/single-user) → E-201 Ines Kovac, deadline 17:00 UTC today

**sev4 (No escalation, 1440 min business hours response):**
- T-2002 (CRM/single-user) → E-202 Tomas Lindqvist, deadline Thu 17:00 UTC
- T-2008 (VPN/single-user) → E-302 Marcus Feld, deadline Thu 17:00 UTC
- T-2009 (build-pipeline/single-user) → E-102 Ravi Menon, deadline Thu 17:00 UTC
- T-2016 (VPN/single-user) → E-302 Marcus Feld, deadline Thu 17:00 UTC

**Key decisions:**
- Applied leave rules: VPN tickets (T-2001, T-2013) assigned to network-secondary (E-303) because network-primary on-call E-301 was on leave
- Recognized T-2007 as security incident (suspected phishing/credential exposure) per handbook
- Accounted for company holiday on 2026-03-25 when calculating sev4 deadlines
- All tickets assigned to engineers on-call at their deadline times
